name: deepseek-r1
desc: Deploy and run your own DeepSeek R1 model for advanced language processing and generation capabilities.
longDesc:
**What is DeepSeek R1?**

DeepSeek R1 is a powerful language model designed for natural text generation and understanding. It offers state-of-the-art performance for various NLP tasks while being efficient and deployable on standard hardware.
